caption: A Meeting of Purpose, Vision & Public Good On 8 July 2026 at 5:00 PM, pursuant to a scheduled appointment at Lok Bhawan, Hyderabad, I had the privilege of meeting His Excellency Shri Shiv Pratap Shukla, Hon’ble Governor of Telangana. The interaction centred upon the institutional initiatives, research-oriented programmes ano nation-building projects undertaken by the Charles Walters Council for Innovation & Research (CWSIR). The occasion also marked the formal extension of an invitation to His Excellency to grace the Honour of Ashoka Award 2026, scheduled for 19 July 2026 at India Habitat Centre, New Delhi, as Programme Chair. Institutions are strengthened not merely by ideas, but by the wisdom to place those ideas in the service of society. A dignified interaction, a meaningful exchange of perspectives, and an enduring reminder that public purpose must always remain the highest measure of leadership. #honourofashokaaward #ashokaaward #excellence #leaadership #bureaucrat

Celebrating the remarkable journey of the legendary Anupam Kher ji, whose dedication, passion, and contribution to Indian cinema have inspired generations across the world. His powerful performances, humble personality, and commitment towards excellence make him a true symbol of inspiration. Being recognised at the Honour of Ashoka Award 2026 is a celebration of his outstanding journey and the impact he continues to create. Congratulations to Anupam Kher ji for this well-deserved honour. May he continue to inspire millions with his talent, wisdom, and incredible work. 🌟🙏 A moment of immense pride and honour 🇮🇳 #honourofashokaaward2026 #anupamkher #inspiration #indiancinema #ashokaaward

Politics Meets Enterprise | Shaping Modern India 🇮🇳 A high-impact political and entrepreneurial discourse took place between Dr Abhishek Verma, billionaire industrialist and Chief National Coordinator, Shiva Sena (NDA), and Abhishek Pandey, Director, Charles Walters Council for Innovation & Research and Convenor, Honour of Ashoka Award. The discussion centered on India's modern political outlook and entrepreneurial roadmap, highlighting startup-driven nation building, policy-industry alignment, youth entrepreneurship, ethical capitalism, and India's evolving global economic leadership. A powerful exchange reinforcing the belief that strong politics and strong enterprise together build a stronger India. #honourofashokaaward #ashokaaward #excellence #leaadership #bureaucrat
